Artoria2e5/PRCoords.body:
PRCoords
========

People's Rectified Coordinates (PRCoords) is a cross-language implementation of "public secret" Chinese coordinate obfuscation methods including GCJ-02 and BD-09, along with general deobfuscation methods previously established in [ChinaMapShift][], [eviltransform][], and [geoChina][]. (Referring to the process of replacing straight lines with wavy ones as a "transform" is euphemism overdone.)

For a background on China's geographic obfuscation, see [Restrictions on geographic data in China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Restrictions_on_geographic_data_in_China#Coordinate_systems) and [Restrictions on surveying and mapping in the People's Republic of China](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中华人民共和国测绘限制) on Wikipedia.

[geoChina]: https://github.com/caijun/geoChina/blob/master/R/cst.R

HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro.body:
# BigFish Dock · BigFishDockpro

A desktop organization and beautification tool for **Windows 10 / 11 x64**. Launch apps with the Dock, organize files with cards, and check your computer status, AI usage, and schedule with the dynamic capsule. The Windows 11 Start menu, search, and notifications can also use the same glass look.

[Download releases](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/releases) · [User guide](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/blob/HEAD/使用说明.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md) · [Issue tracker](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/issues)

*Interface demos use original backgrounds and sample data. Glass panels use 90% opacity.*

## Download and Getting Started

| Version | How to use |
| --- | --- |
| Installer | Run `BigFishDockpro-Setup-x64.exe` and follow the setup wizard. |
| Portable single-file version | Place `BigFishDockpro.exe` in a fixed location and run it. Python does not need to be installed. |

1. Drag shortcuts into the Dock, and drag files or folders into desktop storage cards.
2. Right-click the Dock to open settings, adjust the material, position, and icons, and enable desktop widgets as needed.
3. When changing computers, export your configuration from “Data and Backup.” Both versions share the configuration in `%APPDATA%\BigFishDock`.

## Dock and Desktop Storage

The Dock supports grouping, icon reflections, circular icons, auto-hide, window switching, and unified search. Right-click to manage apps in bulk, or save multiple layouts.

“Settings → Appearance and System → Mouse Style” lets you preview, import, and apply static or animated cursors. The installer and portable single-file version both include 11 built-in schemes: Bibata Amber, Bibata Ice White, Spirit, Tinted Glass, Future, Layan White, Phinger Light, W11 Light, Kugou Old Skin, Luffy, and GrokBot-Soft-Pointer. The Dock quick settings and tray right-click menu can cycle between cursor schemes and the system default.

Desktop storage can sort items by app, folder, document, image, and more. Cards can be placed independently, merged into tabbed pages, searched, or collapsed into capsules or spheres. Files stay in their original locations, and organization actions can be undone.

In “Settings → Dock Appearance,” you can preview and choose from nine themes. “Obsidian Copper Edge” pairs a graphite satin finish with a warm copper trim. “Celadon Glaze” uses a pale cyan glaze and dark green outline. “Sunset Velvet” spreads soft coral light across a raspberry velvet surface. “Overall Appearance” can sync the theme to desktop widgets.

# Enso Plugin Marketplace

Source repository for the EnsoCode official plugin marketplace · [Browse plugins](https://enso-plugins.j3.do/) · [Submit a plugin](#贡献插件)

Community members submit plugins via Pull Request. After merging into `main`, CI packages and signs them, then publishes the artifacts to the `dist` branch. A Cloudflare Worker (`enso-plugins.j3.do`) fetches from `dist` to origin and caches the content in R2.

Clients trust no single distribution node. They only verify the **Ed25519 signature** and the **sha256** of the zip.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

YU-RIS engine compatible runtime kernel: packet parsing, script execution and rendering are gradually being aligned with the official engine, with support for localized text and unified encoding.
NotFaceGUI/yuris-kernel.body:
Use the observable behavior of the official engine as the sole source of truth

## Introduction `yuris-kernel` is a compatible runtime for the YU-RIS engine. The repository does not contain official engine code, game data, or save files. - **Multi-version coverage** —— Official BETA 2 / BETA 3 / BETA 4 series: BETA 4 mainline (0.450–0.495); BETA 3 (0.276–0.292) / BETA 2 (0.255) adaptation in progress; official commercial 5xx branch (v500 packs / v555 seven tables) adaptation in progress; 27 system variable ABI tables for 0.255–0.495 have been registered, plus a measured v555 1000-slot table (`docs/formats/v555-*`). - **Dual rendering backends** —— `soft` (CPU, deterministic reference) and `wgpu` (GPU, primary path for desktop / Android). - **Multiple hosts** —— Windows desktop, headless / local service, browser rendering (debugging), Android. - **Localization and saves** —— Four text routes: `original` / `gbk` / `big5` / `tunnel`; `translate.json` replaces character names, options, UI, and body text at runtime (CP932 automatically expands the tunnel); `.sd` saves are byte-identical to desktop. - **Observability** —— `yu-trace` record / replay / diff, used for frame-by-frame comparison with the official engine. ## Supported Scope ### Engine Versions Official versions are divided into three mainline series: BETA 2 / BETA 3 / BETA 4. 5xx is the official YU-RIS commercial branch (commercial release) and does not belong to these three mainlines. Release packages of some commercial samples may include repackaging or localization processing, but that is sample-level handling, not the engine itself.

Yohann0617/oci-helper-serverless-cf.description: Original project oci-helper, fully refactored security-hardened edition, based on Cloudflare Workers + D1, zero server cost, deployable with one button click
Yohann0617/oci-helper-serverless-cf.body:
# OCI Helper Serverless (deployed to Cloudflare Workers)
> Original project: https://github.com/Yohann0617/oci-helper

One-click deploy the **OCI instance grabber / instance management panel** to your own Cloudflare account.

## Features

- **One-click deployment**: The Deploy button automatically forks the repository. In the wizard, just click "Create new database" to create D1, with no need to create the database in the console beforehand.
- The database schema is **automatically created by the Worker on the first request**, so no SQL commands need to be run.
- Only one Worker and one D1 database are needed. Once deployed, it can be used through a browser.

## Must-read before deploying

- After clicking the Deploy button, Cloudflare will **copy this repository to your own GitHub account** (a Fork, which cannot be turned off), then complete the build and deployment on that copy.
- The deployment wizard will ask you to click "Create new database" in the D1 binding row and enter a name (e.g. `oci-helper-serverless`). After confirming, Cloudflare automatically creates the database and writes the real `database_id` back into the repository copy under your account, so there is no need to create the database in the console in advance.
- If the D1 item does not appear in the wizard, or the deployment reports a `database_id`-related error, see "Method 2" below to manually add a database. This does not affect usage.

## Method 1: Deploy button (automatic Fork + create D1 via wizard) (recommended 🏆)

1. Click the **Deploy to Cloudflare** button at the top of the page, and authorize GitHub and Cloudflare respectively.
2. The wizard will list the resources to be created: the Worker name defaults to `oci-helper-serverless` (editable); the D1 binding is `DB`, and in its row click **Create new database / Create new**, with the name `oci-helper-serverless` (customizable, used only as an identifier). The wizard will automatically create the database and inject the `database_id` into the repository copy under your account, all without leaving the wizard.
3. Click deploy and wait for the build to complete.
4. After deployment completes, go to Worker → **Settings → Variables and Secrets** and add `AUTH_PASSWORD`, `AUTH_SECRET`, and `KEY_SECRET` (see "Required steps after deployment" below).
5. Open the Worker domain (e.g. `https://oci-helper-serverless.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev`) and log in. The first request will automatically create the tables.

> To update later: go to your forked repository and click **Sync fork → Update branch**. Cloudflare will automatically redeploy.

# OpenRung for OpenWrt (x86_64)

OpenRung CLI + LuCI management package for KWRT/OpenWrt x86_64.

> **License:** The code written for this project is released under **GNU GPL-3.0-or-later**. The OpenRung client and third-party components integrated by this project must still comply with their respective upstream licenses and copyright notices; please also review [LICENSE](https://github.com/mengxianbo/openwrt-openrung/blob/HEAD/LICENSE) and [OpenRung upstream license](https://github.com/openrung/openrung/blob/main/LICENSE).

## Current Implementation

- `openrung-client`: Linux amd64 CLI compiled from the official OpenRung source code.
- `luci-app-openrung`: Chinese LuCI configuration page, which can modify the local proxy listening port and display the actual listening address and port.
- procd background service: uses `connect -headless`, starts at boot, and restarts automatically without limit.
- **Configurable local listening port**: default `127.0.0.1:44025`; modify "Local listening port" on the LuCI page, save, and restart the service to take effect.
- procd explicitly sets `HOME=/root` and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/root/.config`, to prevent the Go client from failing to initialize due to a missing HOME in the minimal service environment.
- LuCI status check examines the actual TCP listening address/port and, combined with procd status, distinguishes between "Listening", "Process started but not listening", and "Service not running".
- PassWall integration: when running `openrung-client check`, if PassWall was running originally, it is paused first and automatically resumed after detection completes; if it was originally off, it remains off.
- Uses local proxy mode without TUN by default. TUN is currently disabled because the target device does not have `/dev/net/tun`.

## LuCI Port Modification

Go to the OpenRung page, modify "Local listening port" (1–65535), save and apply, then restart OpenRung. The status bar will display the actual listening address and port. The default port is 44025.

mingminghh611/UL10nForge.body:
# UL10nForge · Unity Game Localization Tool **Localize your Unity game with mature hooks and AI translation, without modifying any original game files** Static UI pre-translated · Dialogue translated live as you play · Press `Alt+L` in-game to edit translations on the spot · Supports local offline and online APIs · One-click packaging of offline patches for sharing --- ## How It Works: Why Is It Safe? Traditional Unity localization usually requires unpacking, rewriting game asset files, and repacking them. This is not only tedious, but also prone to black screens, font garbling, and corrupted saves, and everything becomes invalid after a game update. **UL10nForge uses a "display-layer hook" approach that never touches the original game files**, directly integrating and automatically configuring the two most mature open-source components in the Unity community: - **Plugin loader**: `BepInEx 5 / 6` (automatically detects Mono / IL2CPP, 32-bit / 64-bit, and Unity version; IL2CPP 64-bit can also switch to `MelonLoader` with one click) - **Text interception and replacement engine**: `XUnity.AutoTranslator (XUAT)` When the game starts, the hook intercepts English text at the moment it is about to be displayed on screen: 1. **Check the local dictionary first (zero latency)**: Sentences previously translated or manually edited are instantly displayed in Chinese from `00_UL10nForge.txt`, without consuming any compute or requiring a network connection; 2. **New lines are translated in real time and saved permanently**: Dynamic dialogue/new item text not yet in the dictionary is immediately sent to this tool for parallel translation, shown on screen as soon as it is done, and automatically written to the local dictionary. **Translate once, and it appears instantly forever after.** 3. **100% lossless and reversible**: No `.assets`, `.dll`, or save files are modified at any point. When you no longer want it, uninstall with one click in the workbench; only the files this tool placed are removed according to the install manifest, so other mods you installed will not be accidentally deleted. ```mermaid flowchart LR A["1. Select Unity game directory
Automatically detect engine architecture and version"] --> B["2. Read-only scan of static UI
Extract only safe UI, do not touch code scripts"] B --> C{"Translation mode"} C -- "Standard mode" --> D["Identify game background and proper nouns
Batch translation + post-review correction"] C -- "Direct mode (inference disabled)" --> E["Skip background and review
Direct fast batch translation"] D --> F["3. Auto-deploy BepInEx + XUAT hooks
Match Chinese font and export dictionary"] E --> F F --> G["4. Launch game and play
Dynamic dialogue translated in real time with low latency
Press Alt+L anytime to edit floating translations, effective immediately"] G --> H["5. Export dictionary / package offline patch .zip
Send to friends, extract and play"] ``` ---

molimao/iota.description: Open-source, five-language mining dashboard for IOTA Train at Home, PRL, BNT, XMR, ERG, ZEPH and more: saved addresses, worker status, available rewards and optional Mac agent controls.
molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem. Each project's inputs, cycles and data coverage are explained separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity. The figures are official data as of the time the screenshot was taken.

w3c0929/myscoop.body:
# myscoop

Personal Scoop Bucket repository that collects Windows software from GitHub, with support for one-click installation and automatic updates.

## Quick Install (Recommended)

If you don't want to run the commands below one by one, use the one-click restore script:

> **Before running the script for the first time (required)**: open PowerShell and run `Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser` once (this allows local scripts; remote scripts still need to be signed).

**Windows 10 / 11**

1. Download [`restore-scoop-backup.ps1`](https://github.com/w3c0929/myscoop/raw/main/restore-scoop-backup.ps1) (right-click → Save as)
2. Right-click the script → **Run with PowerShell**
3. The script automatically installs Scoop and Git and adds all buckets
4. When it finishes, go to `D:\scoop\buckets\myscoop` and **run `symlink.bat` as administrator** to complete the deployment

**Windows 7**

The PowerShell version bundled with Windows 7 is too old, so you need to install WMF 5.1 first:

1. Download [Win7-WMF5.1-x64.zip](https://github.com/w3c0929/myscoop/releases/download/vWin7WMF/Win7-WMF5.1-x64.zip)
2. After extracting, double-click `Win7AndW2K8R2-KB3191566-x64.msu` to run it, then **restart your computer**
3. Then follow steps 1–4 from the Windows 10/11 section above

wushuai0802/myfinder-device-battery.body:
# MyFinder Device Battery

A multi-brand wireless mouse, headset, and keyboard battery card for Windows. It supports MyDockFinder / MyFinder and can also be used on its own as a system tray application.

Current source version **1.4.1-beta.1** (beta), for Windows 10/11 x64. The native UI uses the system .NET Framework. The release package bundles the device-reading component, so users do not need to install Python, vendor drivers, or enter VID/PID. For publicly downloadable versions, the Releases page is authoritative. Older versions remain in the historical Releases.

1.4.1-beta.1 adds grade C, read-only battery reading candidates for the Razer VT9 PRO dual 8K (`24AE:1221`) and the VT9 PRO (`24AE:1205` / `4405`). For mice across all brands, it greatly expands DPI reading and DPI-level switching candidates: Logitech HID++ 2.0 `0x2201` full series and GPW3 `0x8100` read-only #1052, Razer 64 models 90B #558 and Viper V4 Pro #872, the CompX series (139 models), Maicong V2 & A5 Gen1, ROG Harpe Ace, WLmouse #405, Lamzu Maya X, G-Wolves, and Dareu 2.4G `260D:1156`. All of these are grade C and await real-device verification. It also polishes the WinForms visual hierarchy and popup brand icons, adds automatic avoidance for third-party taskbar battery overlay plugins, adds horizontal mouse dragging, and fixes the issue where the app did not auto-hide during fullscreen and borderless games.

1.4.0 final consolidates 1.4.0-beta.1 through beta.7 and the community hardware adaptations merged afterward. These include ATK 8K dongle-M1, WOB Rainy75 V2, Xiaomi Wireless Mouse 4 Pro, G-Wolves MINI 60 HE PRO, ROG Youxia 2 96 Wireless, VGN Dragonfly F3 MasterGT, Nuomiao AM Infinity .97, the Betop Kunpeng gamepad series, the Valkyrie VK series, Logitech PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE, and Razer BlackShark V2/V3. All newly added devices are grade C and await real-device verification. This release also introduces a new “Control Center,” a Graphite theme, a desktop battery widget that supports elastic edge hiding, an experimental taskbar battery overlay, a local read-only API, in-app feedback with image attachments (EXIF data is stripped automatically), and experimental auto-detection and single-device read-pause control. It also fixes the shutdown popup (#1085) and config rollback (#1023) issues. For full notes, see the [Changelog](https://github.com/wushuai0802/myfinder-device-battery/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md).

xycvip/HongGuoTV.body:
---

Hongguo TV is an Android TV client for Hongguo short dramas. The UI is written from scratch with native Kotlin + Compose, and playback uses ExoPlayer.
**The data layer is not in the APK**: the catalog, details, playback URLs, danmaku, and accounts are all handled by a `main.js` script that is delivered from the cloud and runs locally on the device.

Updating the script does not require a new release. This is the most important design decision in this project.

zhuobichen/weflow-cli.description: A local-first WeChat data tool: chat history query and export, daily digest of public account articles, and a personal knowledge base (MCP compatible)
zhuobichen/weflow-cli.body:
**Simplified Chinese** · [English](https://github.com/zhuobichen/weflow-cli/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

*People today do not see the moon of ancient times; the moon today once shone on the people of old.*

> Heaven and earth are the inn of all things; time is the passing guest of a hundred generations.

> Bring chat records, public account reading, and personal knowledge workflows back to your local computer.

**WeFlow CLI turns WeChat into your local second brain.** Four things, all done on your machine: it does not log in to your account and does not upload chat content.

| | What you get | Where to start |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 💬 **Chat history** | Query and search by person, group, or time; export to HTML you can browse directly (including images and voice transcriptions) | `weflow-cli export` |
| 📰 **Public accounts** | Organize subscribed account articles into a daily briefing with AI summaries, which can be pushed by email | `weflow-cli daily` |
| ⭐ **Favorites** | Read the local favorites library and search by type and keyword (articles, images, links) | `weflow-cli fav list` |
| 🧠 **Knowledge base** | Articles and chats are distilled into semantically searchable notes and a concept graph | `weflow-cli search` · `weflow-cli wiki` |

Supports Windows and Linux. It has an MCP interface that can be connected to AI editors such as Claude Code.

It specifically answers **questions WeChat itself cannot answer**: who is waiting for my reply, what I promised whom and whether I later delivered, which relationships are fading, how a given account's views have changed, and what we were talking about on this day in past years.

> **Local-first**: data is processed on the local machine by default, with no built-in telemetry. Explicitly chosen online services and cloud AI make network requests. For the encryption of configured keys, the separate key cache, and the optional plaintext database cache, which have different security boundaries, see the [Security and Privacy Statement](https://github.com/zhuobichen/weflow-cli/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md).

> This project is limited to processing data you have the right to access. Please comply with applicable laws, WeChat rules, and the privacy boundaries of others.

> **⚠️ Usage boundaries and risks**: Only use this project on devices you control, to process data you own or are explicitly authorized to access. Do not use it to monitor, track, or read other people's WeChat data, and do not deploy it on others' devices or run it remotely and silently. Before use, confirm the applicable laws, WeChat terms of service, and account permissions yourself. Third-party tools may trigger account risk controls, restrictions, or bans. This project does not constitute legal advice, and users bear responsibility for their own use.
